entries.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://api.capgo.app/mcp: manage Capacitor apps, live update bundles, channels and rollouts, devices, statistics, native builds, webhooks and push notifications, and search the Capgo docs. OAuth 2.0 sign-in.
representativeQueries: roll out a Capacitor live update to 10% of devices
list the bundles and channels of my Capgo app
check why my iOS native build failed
search the Capgo docs for channel overrides

entries.description: REST API (OpenAPI 3.1) for Capgo organizations, apps, channels, bundles, devices, statistics and API keys.
representativeQueries: create a Capgo channel with the REST API
get Capgo app statistics for the last 30 days

entries.description: Use Capgo's public API docs and authentication model to manage organizations, apps, channels, devices, bundles, statistics, and API keys.
representativeQueries: automate Capgo releases from a script
call the Capgo API with an API key

entries.description: Connect to the hosted Capgo MCP server at api.capgo.app/mcp, or run the local Capgo CLI MCP server for bundle uploads and native builds.
representativeQueries: connect my coding agent to Capgo
upload a Capacitor bundle from my agent

entries.description: Use Capgo's browser-based signing tools to generate iOS CSRs, create Android keystores, and capture iPhone or iPad UDIDs.
representativeQueries: generate an iOS certificate signing request

entries.description: Route developers to the right Capgo pages for pricing, native builds, signing tools, API docs, AI skills, and enterprise workflows.
representativeQueries: find the Capgo native build docs
